suggested_requirements.text: The system shall provide a categorized view of the entire inventory to the Construction Junction staff.
The system shall allow administrators to define inventory departments.
The system shall allow administrators to define inventory categories.
The system shall allow administrators to customize attributes and details for inventory items.
The system shall allow authorized staff to add items to the inventory.
The system shall allow authorized staff to modify, delete, or split existing inventory items.
The system shall suggest item prices based on historical data of similar items.
The system shall allow authorized staff to view past and current acquisitions.
The system shall allow authorized staff to process the receipt of donated items.
The system shall update inventory records when an item is sold via QuickBooks POS.
The system shall provide a reporting mechanism for inventory, acquisitions, and donor information.
The application shall operate via a touch screen user interface.
The system shall require user login for access to the application.
The system shall restrict access to screens and functions based on user role.
The system shall record changes to application entities including the user and timestamp.
The system shall perform with consistently and predictably low response times.
